name: Semaglutide
description: A long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonist. Approved as Ozempic for type 2 diabetes, as Wegovy for chronic weight management and cardiovascular risk reduction in obesity, and as Rybelsus in an oral formulation.

systems.note: GLP-1 receptor agonism on the beta cell driving glucose-dependent insulin secretion; the intended site of action.
Lean mass falls with total mass; the loss is not fat-selective.
Hepatobiliary and gallbladder events are labelled.
Lipid values move with weight change rather than with any lipid intervention.

monitors.why: The direct index of glycaemic effect.
Interval tracking of the glycaemic response.
Separates lean-mass loss from fat loss.
